title: fix: choose shorter quotes for minified URLs
author: SyMind
summary: When minifying, serializes url() strings with single quotes if that needs fewer escapes (e.g. SVG data URIs with double-quoted attributes). Pure size optimization with a hand-written single-quote serializer; well tested (round-trip over 2,744 combos), but escaping code is exactly where a minifier can silently break URLs, so it needs a careful review rather than a fast merge.
evidence: master 574eee2 CLI --minify keeps `url("data:image/svg+xml,<svg width=\"1\" ...")` with backslash-escaped quotes. No maintainer comments. Output-size only; no correctness bug fixed. Review focus: serialize_single_quoted_string writes raw `"` and delegates the rest to CssStringWriter in slices - check hex-escape terminators across slice boundaries.
